newsitem.title: JAPAN: Lead content of Japan batteries sold in Sept rises.
newsitem.headline: Lead content of Japan batteries sold in Sept rises.

text.p: The lead content of batteries sold in Japan in September rose a marginal 0.5 percent from the same month last year to 26,517 tonnes, the Japan Storage Battery Association said on Monday.
The lead content of automotive batteries sold that month edged up 0.3 percent year-on-year to 20,243 tonnes, while the figure for industrial-use batteries was up 0.7 percent at 3,807 tonnes.
Total domestic shipments of automotive batteries in September were off 0.6 percent at 2,438,882 units, while export shipments rose 1.9 percent to 71,214 units.

For the first half of the fiscal year ending March 1997, the lead content of batteries sold was up 2.2 percent from the year-ago period at 126,696 tonnes, including a 0.7 percent gain in automotive batteries to 93,003 tonnes and a 14.0 percent rise in industrial-use batteries to 20,380 tonnes.

Domestic shipments of automotive batteries in the half-year were up 0.6 percent year-on-year at 10,996,610 units, while exports were up 1.4 percent at 363,141 units. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-6179
